author: orchestrator (CC), relayed
prose: Lab line endings, from the orchestrator (relayed 2026-11-16): Measured on yoga: with core.autocrlf=true, every gate run writes the lab as LF over a CRLF checkout. That leaves 98 of 131 lab files stat-dirty with an empty diff (--ignore-cr-at-eol gives 0 changes). Every drain check and every "dirty=0" gate on a Windows box after a recompile then reads dirt that isn't real. Intent: CairnCommons carries a .gitattributes with "intentions-congruency-lab/** text eol=lf", so a recompile on Windows leaves the tree clean.
